concept.title: Notices the Brake
concept.hook: Low rear-wheel-level shot of a bike on a dusk lane, the red lens glowing steady in deep blacks. Overlay: Your light should notice when you brake.
concept.surpriseBeat: A single slow-motion beat: the rider squeezes the brake and the frosted red lens swells brighter while the music pulse builds.

locations.description: City bike lane at dusk with passing traffic blurred in the background
locations.lighting: warm fading sky, cool blue shadows, deep blacks so the red glow pops

locations.description: Tidy apartment entryway with a bike leaning on the wall

scenes.action: The bike rolls away from camera along the lane, the light glowing steady red. The commuter in an olive shell jacket and plain helmet rides unhurried.
scenes.framing: Low, rear-wheel level, light centered in frame
scenes.motion: Rider pedals steadily away, passing traffic softly blurred
scenes.lighting: Dusk blue with deep blacks, red glow popping
scenes.overlayText: Your light should notice when you brake.
scenes.sound: Soft traffic hum, tire hiss, downtempo bassline begins

scenes.action: In the entryway, the commuter sets the light against the seat post and clips the rubber strap on in one quick motion.
scenes.framing: Medium close on the seat post, label side facing camera, hands enter late and stay clear of the label
scenes.motion: One smooth clip-on, then the hand lifts away

scenes.action: Back on the lane, the commuter rolls through the evening commute, backpack on, with a passing rider in the background.
scenes.framing: Wide side view of rider and bike with traffic lights behind
scenes.sound: Muted electric piano chords, distant traffic

scenes.action: The rider squeezes the brake and the frosted red lens glows brighter, in slow motion.
scenes.framing: Rear view, light filling the lower half of the frame, shallow depth of field
scenes.lighting: Cool blue dusk, intense red glow
scenes.sound: Music pulse builds, soft brake squeak

scenes.action: Clean close-up of the light on the seat post, glowing steady, held still.
scenes.framing: Product close-up, centered, label readable by shape
scenes.sound: Bassline settles, a single soft chord

rubric.reason: Closely follows the brief's real product behavior with a clear brake-glow beat. Reliable and clean, but the surprise is expected rather than unexpected.

concept.title: Dusk Already Knows
concept.hook: Golden-hour rear view of the light flashing in a slow, even pattern. Overlay: Dusk arrives. Your light already knows.
concept.surpriseBeat: As the sky shifts from gold to blue in one continuous ride, the flash pattern changes on its own, with no rider action.

locations.description: City bike lane with passing traffic, from golden hour into dusk
locations.lighting: warm gold shifting to cool blue, deep blacks

scenes.action: The light flashes slowly on the seat post as the bike rides away in warm light.
scenes.framing: Mounted view behind the saddle, light in lower center
scenes.overlayText: Dusk arrives. Your light already knows.

scenes.action: The commuter, in a navy shell and reflective trouser cuff, rides on while the strap-mounted light holds steady on the post.
scenes.framing: Side view of the rear wheel, cuff band and light

scenes.action: A passing rider overtakes in the background as street lights flicker on.
scenes.framing: Low at wheel level, lane stretching ahead

scenes.action: The sky turns blue and the light changes its flash pattern, in a single slow-motion beat.
scenes.framing: Rear view, light large in frame, shallow depth of field
scenes.motion: Light pattern shifts as the bike rolls on
scenes.lighting: Cool blue dusk, bright red glow
scenes.overlayText: The flash pattern shifts with the light.
scenes.dialogue: The pattern changes as daylight fades.

scenes.action: Clean close-up of the light on the post, glowing in the blue dusk.

rubric.reason: Showcases the less common daylight-fade feature with a quiet, clever turn. The hook is softer, and the pattern change is subtle for a video model to render.

concept.title: Charged Before Dinner
concept.hook: Close shot of a USB-C cable plugged into the light on a desk, a soft red glow in the dark. Overlay: Charges over USB-C.
concept.surpriseBeat: A whip pan from the desk lands on the same light already glowing brighter at a brake on the dusk lane, jumping from plug-in to the ride.

locations.description: Office bike room with a desk, a charging cable and a bike on the wall
locations.lighting: soft warm window light with cool shadows

locations.description: City bike lane at dusk with passing traffic
locations.lighting: cool blue with deep blacks and a red glow

scenes.action: The light sits on the desk with a USB-C cable plugged in and a faint red glow.
scenes.framing: Close shot, shallow depth of field, phone beside it showing a battery level bar
scenes.lighting: Warm desk light with a red glow
scenes.sound: Soft electric piano, quiet room tone

scenes.action: The commuter unplugs the light and clips it onto the seat post of the bike in one quick motion.
scenes.framing: Top-down on the seat post, hands enter late and never cover the label

scenes.action: The commuter wheels the bike out and begins the evening ride in a plain helmet and roll-top backpack.
scenes.framing: Side view, bike and rider in the lane

scenes.action: Rider squeezes the brake and the lens glows brighter in slow motion.
scenes.framing: Rear low view, light large in frame

scenes.action: Clean close-up of the light on the post, steady glow.

rubric.reason: Covers charging and mount well, but it spreads across several features and the escalation is mild, so the single surprise beat is unclear.
